title: A 2025 Stanford study gave 4,829 Americans AI-generated arguments supporting six different policies and found that participants became modestly more supportive after reading them, with AI messages app
description: New research shows large language models can influence political attitudes. AI-generated messages proved as persuasive as those written by ordinary people. Most participants did not realize the messages came from artificial intelligence. AI persuasion appears to rely on facts, logic, and a dispassionate tone. This raises significant questions about AI's role in democratic processes.

title: Oracle To Face Fresh Round Of Layoffs This Month; Thousands Of Indian Employees To Be Affected
description: Oracle employees in India are reportedly preparing for a fresh round of layoffs, with 2,000–3,000 jobs expected to be affected. The cuts may come in early or mid-September as the company reduces payroll costs while investing heavily in artificial intelligence infrastructure. Oracle has not officially confirmed the reported workforce reduction.

title: G20 AI Regulation: US to press G20 on light
